messages.subject: Increase height of selectInput box
parts:
How can I increase the height of a selectInput box?  For example, here's my selectInput call in the sidebarPanel section of my ui.R file:

    selectInput("yourDrafted", "Players You Drafted:", sort(shinyData$name), multiple=TRUE),

I've read similar threads, but I haven't been able to find something that works for making the combo box (selectInput) taller.  Here's what I've tried:

    wellPanel(uiOutput("var"),tags$style(type='text/css', "#var { height: 400px;}")),
    
    tags$head(
    tags$style(type="text/css", "select { height: 400px; }")
    ),

Any help would be greatly appreciated.  Thanks!
